decision.observation: After Up+Z, Hornet is not clearly visible in the dimly lit east pocket. The stone rubble sits in the center, the cobblestone column with dark pillars is on the right, and thick hanging moss drapes from the top. The camera has not panned upward. She has 1 of 5 masks.
decision.hypothesis: The Up+Z did not reach the upper gap, and she is probably landing back on the rubble or hidden behind the dark foreground. With critical health (1 mask), continuing to test the dangerous upward route to the pale-creature chamber is risky. Exiting west and looking for health restores or safer routes is the better strategy.
decision.memory: Health is critical at 1 of 5 masks after the pale rolling creature fight (cost 4 masks total).
